entries.title: Meadow Markets
entries.tagline: A little farm. A growing adventure.
entries.description: Build your farm, grow crops, care for animals and explore a welcoming village. Start in your browser or take your farm with you on Android.
entries.requirements: Modern browser on phone, tablet or computer, or the Android testing package. Internet access is needed for online features.
instructions: Open Play in browser and follow the farm introduction.
Tap or click a farm plot to plant, water and harvest crops.
Care for your animals, sell produce and use your coins to grow the farm.
Open the in-game help and journal for goals, controls and new activities.
entries.notes: Early access. Browser and Android releases update separately; the browser build shown here is not an Android package build number. For Android, open the downloaded APK and confirm installation if your device requests it.

entries.title: Meadow Market Littles
entries.description: Explore farm adventures, animal care, puzzles and art with Farmer Jade, Farmer Rhys and Farmer Jay. Play four two-player games on one device or pair directly across home Wi-Fi.
entries.requirements: Modern browser on phone, tablet or computer, or the Android testing package. Works in portrait or landscape. Internet access is needed for cloud saves and updates.
instructions: Open Play in browser and choose an activity.
Follow the farmers’ spoken instructions and on-screen controls.
Explore animal games, puzzles and the art studio at your own pace.
On Android, download the APK, open the downloaded file and confirm installation if your device requests it.
For a browser app, open game settings for installation. On iPad, use Safari Share, then Add to Home Screen.
entries.notes: Early access. Android test package version 0.2.0, build 2. Local two-player games use QR pairing on the same Wi-Fi, without an internet game server. Open and cache the game before going offline. Some guest networks block device-to-device connections. Game progress remains separate from Meadow Markets.

entries.title: Bargain Barge
entries.description: Browse Australian and New Zealand retailer offers and community deals, compare listed prices and open retailer pages in this Android testing app.
entries.requirements: Android 8.0 or newer. Internet connection for live feeds. Location permission is optional; you can choose a location manually.
instructions: Download the Android APK on your phone and open the downloaded file.
If Android asks, approve installation from your downloading app, then install and open Bargain Barge.
Select Australia or New Zealand and choose a location or enter a suburb.
Search for an item, filter results and open an offer to refresh its source details. Confirm the final price, delivery and availability with the retailer.
entries.notes: Android app only; there is no browser version. Listed prices are not a guarantee of branch stock or final checkout totals. App updates require your Android installation confirmation.

entries.title: Sponsor Sorter
entries.description: Find sponsorship partners, manage campaigns and conversations, and follow sponsorship activity from your Android phone.
entries.requirements: Android 7.0 or newer on a phone or tablet. Internet connection and a Sponsor Sorter account.
instructions: Open the installation page on your Android phone or tablet.
Download the signed APK and open the downloaded file.
If Android asks, approve installation from your downloading app, then confirm Install.
Open Sponsor Sorter and sign in with your existing account. New Android packages require your installation confirmation.
entries.notes: The public download is build 8. Later test builds are not listed until accepted for release. On iPhone or iPad, use the website.

entries.title: Frontlines: World in Conflict
entries.tagline: Six factions. Forty-two territories. One world to conquer.
entries.description: Command six coalitions across a 3D world board in solo AI, local hot-seat or online campaigns, with local autosave/resume. Build 24 adds expressive faces to the 3D commander creator: blinks, gaze, moving jaw and teeth, and distinct victory, defeat, downward bow, flirt wink, laugh and anger poses. Keep using 64 grouped face controls, gender, optional voices, two-sided hair, plumes and fitted uniforms. Saved portraits keep a neutral front view independent of the editing camera. The game retains thermal protection, pauses local AI while cards are open and saves completed actions immediately.
entries.imageAlt: Frontlines: World in Conflict game artwork
entries.requirements: WebGL 2 and WebAssembly browser, or Android 7.0+ (64-bit ARM). Internet is needed for first load, online play and updates. Phone play is best in landscape.
instructions: Open Play browser preview, choose your game setup, then launch. Set human commanders to zero to watch AI play.
Choose victory and reinforcement rules with the in-game touch pickers before launching. Adjust sound and dice finishes in Settings.
Follow turn prompts to reinforce, attack and move troops. Choose solo AI, local hot-seat or online play.

After occupation, an army that can attack stays selected. A compulsory fifth-card or inherited-hand trade returns the same commander to troop placement; place the trade troops, then continue the turn.
Desktop: wheel to zoom, middle drag to pan, right drag to orbit. On phone, use landscape, drag to pan and pinch to zoom.
Android: download the preview APK, open the downloaded file and confirm installation if Android asks. Android Back pauses or resumes the campaign.
Local campaigns autosave on this device. Use Continue Campaign to continue; clearing game or browser data can remove the save.
Use Field cards to inspect your hand and trade. Choose dice finishes in Settings; use the in-game speed controls for solo or AI spectator play.
Choose Your Commander from the main menu, or Customise in Commander Account. Edit the 3D appearance, then Save Commander to use its portrait; Cancel offers a choice to discard unsaved changes.
Open the card-fan button to inspect your earned hand. Local AI pauses while cards are open; Close resumes play. Shared online tables continue normally.

In the creator, drag to rotate and tilt, use two fingers to pan/pinch, or use the desktop wheel to zoom and right/middle drag to pan. Reset View restores the front composition; Save Commander always captures a front portrait.
Scroll account, creator, Settings and option lists with a vertical swipe. Swipe vertically over a slider to scroll; drag horizontally to change its value. Tap a field to enter text.

Use the Face group menu for cheeks, jaw/chin, nose and other facial controls. Gender and Voice are in Presets; voice is independent of appearance. Preview Voice plays the selected set; adjust Commander volume in Settings.

Open Pose to choose an editor animation, or Still to stop it; Replay restarts the action. Saved portraits keep their front composition. Custom commanders can use the player-card panel for limited public or private emotes.
entries.notes: Playtest preview. Exact build 24 native acceptance used ADB, not an in-app updater test; actual 23-to-24 OTA acceptance is recorded separately after completion. Native checks selected all eight modes, observed distinct expressions and idle eyelids, raw touch/scroll, orbit and neutral canonical save/restart, retained recipe values and military campaign progress, and an actual table Laugh then neutral and bubble. Resume/host-build/social metadata changes are documented. Browser checks on the exact PCK passed desktop and portrait/landscape controls, bounded facial motion, side-view animated save becoming neutral/front-facing after reload, and an actual custom-commander campaign Laugh. Physical native pinch and rotation were not injected. Fresh automation: 35 Godot jobs with 16,207 counted assertions plus four Node jobs with 773 counted assertions and two exports; interruption recovery is documented and final AI/LAN/Node/export gates reran. The test phone reached thermal status 2 on Ultra60 and adapted to 30 FPS; a separate 180-second idle draft observation on Balanced30 stayed at thermal 0. This is not a broad-device battle endurance benchmark. Long Pose labels truncate in compact native landscape; the full picker is legible. Painted NPC portraits remain static. Voice jaw motion follows amplitude, not phoneme lip sync; subjective voice quality and parity with the painted artwork remain unaccepted. Service 8 evidence is carried from build 23; no backend/Auth/schema changes. Human email/recovery/friend journeys, complete native game-to-victory and broad-device coverage remain open. Local saves exclude online room state and passwords. No paid cosmetic shop or universal 60 FPS claim. Carried historical evidence: Hosted build 15 checks passed the previous stale-board case: board and labels stayed aligned through High/Ultra transitions, Balanced30 zoom/reset, campaign and reload/continue. Physical sensor confirmation was on build 13; this is historical evidence. Solo pause and resume were checked in hosted play on build 11.
